paper_id: RLER-TTE_ An Efficient and Effective Framework for En Route Travel Time Estimation with Reinforcement Learning
title: RLER-TTE: An Efficient and Effective Framework for En Route Travel Time Estimation with Reinforcement Learning
motivation: TTE服务器每日处理数十亿实时请求，现有方法对每个请求都调用高复杂度模型重算，精度提升甚微却造成巨大计算压力
problem_framing: 将在线决策问题建模为MDP，通过强化学习智能决定是否调用重算模型或复用历史结果
key_insight: 在ER-TTE流程中引入轻量级Decision Maker先判断新数据是否有价值，再决定是否触发Predictor重算
method_signature: Decision Maker + Predictor双模块架构，Decision Maker用Double DQN做action selection，Predictor存储历史结果供lookup
evaluation_criteria: 准确率(MAPE/RMSE)与效率(模型调用频率)的综合权衡
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 现有训练策略使用固定比例的traveled route，导致模型无法有效处理不同比例的请求
evidence_for_taste: computational stress on the TTE servers
model performs poorly when handling prediction requests with different proportions
existing methods fail to consider the complexity of real-world scenarios
thinking_moves: 把系统层面的效率问题重新定义为agent的决策问题
从工程异常(服务器负载)反推需要引入决策机制
将online/offline特征的关联性作为attention fusion的核心
用contrastive learning对齐online和offline feature space
